summary: Fentress County tower (1,687 ft) moved to Pickett in 1972; footings and an old cabin remain here, and the Pickett tower is listed as standing.

facts.status_note: Tower moved to Pickett in 1972. Cement footings and an old cabin remain at this site.

events.note: Tower moved to Pickett, per the Tennessee lookout tower list.

notes_for_editor: The move to Pickett and the remaining footings and cabin come from one author's list (tnlandforms); no second source found. The Pickett entry gives only a name and county, so 'Pickett' could mean a state forest or park there; the sources do not say which, and the Pickett site address is not known. Pickett State Forest (tn.gov) returned HTTP 403 and was not read; the Pickett CCC park plan was read but does not mention the tower. No build date, staffing or fire history found after two web searches and the cached pages.
